description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
